bounds.domain: One request operation in flight, two payload values, one policy replacement, clock 0..3 and approval lifetime two ticks. Retains the previous reservation, single-use approval, signer-failure and final-audit obligations.
bounds.boundary: The policy must still match after submission evidence commits and before dispatch. Policy changes retire pending approval. A change after signer dispatch cannot retract an already dispatched signature.
bounds.assumptions: Provider cryptography, authorization at HTTP boundaries, concrete policy values, multiple concurrent request/reservation budgets and external signer unknown outcomes remain outside this projection. A rejected signer operation is assumed not to have produced a usable signature.
bounds.progress: Weak fairness of audit settlement, human decision and signer settlement ensures the current request returns or fails. No progress is asserted for an absent decision or permanently unavailable dependency.
bounds.conformance: The actual SQLite/ethers suite checks immutable admitted payload, repeated approval, pending-policy invalidation, policy replacement while submission audit waits, durable audit failures and recovery. Scenario conformance does not prove all abstract schedules.

assumptions: Checked formula in services_signing: RequestEventuallySettles = FairWork.implies(always( not(settledPhases.contains(s.phase)).implies(eventually(settledPhases.contains(s.phase)))))

Model fairness predicate FairWork = and { submissionSettles.weakFair(s), rejectionSettles.weakFair(s), approvalDecided.weakFair(s), signerSettles.weakFair(s), failureAuditSettles.weakFair(s), finalAuditSettles.weakFair(s), }
The property is conditional on its written model fairness and environmental premises. Real scheduler fairness, provider completion and implementation refinement are not proved.
